'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male gladiator participating in the Hunt in [[Sanguis Plateaus]], [[Septimont]]. He makes his first appearance in {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}} then can be found next to a [[Wooter]] after outside of the [[Tetragon Temple]].
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Tomas''': I have a bad feeling about this one…
:'''Tomas''': I just want one last sip of Heartpour. Not sure we'll make it back.
:{{DIcon}} (Hand over a bottle of Heartpour.)
::'''Tomas''': What?! You got a bottle on you? Miracle. Didn't think I'd get to try it here.
::'''Tomas''': That's it. Just like I remember.
::'''Tomas''': Thank you. If we get out of this, next drink is on me.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} (Don't hand it over.)
----
;(Afterwards)
:'''Tomas''': Hey, it's you! The one who gave me the Heartpour.
:'''Tomas''': Never imagined you were the destined Hero of Heroes...
:'''Tomas''': Now we're both back, it's time I kept my promise.
:'''Tomas''': Come on! Drinks are on me. Let's get wrecked!

==Related Dialogues== 
;Down at the [[Hunter's Den]]
;(Idle)
:'''Elliot:''' New supplies just came in. Please check the inventory when you can.
:'''Elliot:''' Do let us know if you have any additional requests. We'll do our best to meet them!
:'''Romilda:''' Thanks. I'll go over the supply list first.
;(Dialogue)
:'''Romilda:''' Everything's checked. Once the hunt begins, the Gladiators will be sent all over the hunting grounds. We'll be counting on you for more supply runs.
:'''Romilda:''' By the way, why is there a crate of Heartpour in this delivery? It's not listed.
:'''Elliot:''' Freebies from the sponsor. They even sent their own crew to drop it off.
:'''Elliot:''' Everyone's doing their part for this hunt. Just think of it as a gesture of goodwill.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Note==
* Giving him a [[Heartpour]] does not grant any trophy nor will be taken out of your inventory.
* Regardless if you gave Tomas a [[Heartpour]] or not, he still thanks you for giving him one.
